key_insight: A particle-based Lagrangian visualization can expose coherent heat-transport pathways and finite-time attracting/repelling structures that are hidden in standard Eulerian temperature fields.
engineering_relevance: This gives engineers a more mechanism-aware way to diagnose and optimize unsteady convective heat transfer in thermal systems.
method: Advect massless particles through a time-reparameterized spacetime formulation of thermal transport.
Accumulate particle path contributions to reveal coherent transport routes.
Identify finite-time attracting and repelling structures despite aperiodic, non-conservative heat transport.
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a visualization technique and qualitative capability demonstration, showing that the method reveals transport structures conventional temperature-field views cannot capture.
watch_item: Because heat transport is aperiodic and non-conservative, the approach may be sensitive to trajectory integration and time-reparameterization choices.
paper_title: Visualizing Lagrangian Heat Transport Paths and Density Structures in Unsteady Heat Transfer
